notes.admin_checklist:
## What was asked for (The new order form refuses nonsense orders)

1 of 5 things that were asked for are working, 4 are not.

- ❌ Not met: A customer can only order a whole number of items, from 1 to 1000; anything else is refused with a clear message. — The system accepts orders for 0, negative, fractional and more than 1000 items.
- ❌ Not met: An order with no items is refused. — An order with no items is accepted.
- ❌ Not met: Order totals are worked out correctly: 5% off orders of 1,000.00 or more, then 10% tax on the discounted amount. — The discount works but tax is worked out before it, so large orders are over-charged.
- ❌ Not met: A customer can only open their own company's orders; another company's order shows as not available. — Another company's order can be opened instead of being shown as not available.
- ✅ Met: An order placed in the Client Portal appears in My Orders with its reference and total. — A valid order placed in the portal shows in My orders with its reference and correct total.
